fib: ______ means beliefs or customs handed down from the past to the present or posterity.
Tradition means beliefs or customs handed down from the past to the present or posterity.
______ is the largest ethnic group in Northern Nigeria and by extension the whole country.
Hausa is the largest ethnic group in Northern Nigeria and by extension the whole country.
______ is made up of an agrarian population, where the economy and social life revolve round agriculture.
Nupe Occupations Nupe land is made up of an agrarian population, where the economy and social life revolve round agriculture.
______ are known as great merchants and traders, whose trading have taken them to various part of the Bini and Yoruba kingdom.
The Bini people are known as great merchants and traders, whose trading have taken them to various part of the Bini and Yoruba kingdom.
______ is defined as the complex whole that consists of all the ways we think and do and everything we have as members of society.
Culture is defined as the complex whole that consists of all the ways we think and do and everything we have as members of society.
